
DELETE-TAG
Delete a tag from the registry

USAGE
  fspec delete-tag <tag> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <tag> (required)
    Tag to delete

OPTIONS
  --force
    Skip confirmation
  --dry-run
    Show what would be deleted without making changes

EXAMPLES
  1. Delete tag
  $ fspec delete-tag @deprecated
  ✓ Deleted tag @deprecated

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec register-tag
  fspec list-tags

NOTES
  • Tag must not be in use in any feature files
  • Run validate-tags after deletion to verify
